objective: max median log(E_24h / start), E = cash + open cost after every market of the day is paid
tie_break: higher p10 of 24 h log growth
choose_on: selection hours (before 2026-10-13 00:00 UTC), arm v1_frozen, hold `old` (195 live orders of 2026-10-13), redeem 120 s after the market end
stage1: every grid point, 200 bootstrap 24 h paths; keep the 100 best medians among points with P(<$50 in 24 h) <= 0.08 on the screen
stage2: finalists: 2000 bootstrap 24 h paths + all 288-market rotations (24 h) + 1000 bootstrap 7 d paths; constraints must hold on bootstrap and rotations; winner = best bootstrap median
report_only: test hours (both arms), hold `new` (bot run 2026-10-14) and `fast50`, redeem 1 h, $26 start, ablation of each cap from the winner, live config (60 sh, no caps, no fit)

amendments.what: side policies (b) per-side fill cap, opposite side free and (c) hedge only (an opposite order is capped at the net share imbalance, so it never raises the market's worst-case loss) added to (a) one direction and (d) none, on the coordinator's request, before any path was scored

stage 2 found no grid point meeting P(ever < $25 in 7 d) <= 1% (best 5.4%): a daily drawdown pause cannot stop a run of bad days. Added an all-time-peak floor halt (0.5 / 0.6 / 0.7, the 'never lose everything' mechanism) to the whole grid; stage 1b = 200 7 d bootstrap paths on the 2,000 best stage-1 points per floor, stage 2 = the 100 best 24 h medians among points with stage-1b P(< $25 in 7 d) <= 2%; the user's update (sizing must compound) restricts the winner to fraction / Kelly sizing, the best fixed-size point is reported beside it. Test hours still unscored.
amendments.scored_before: selection hours only (stage 1 + 2); test hours unscored
